correctness.rationale: For the complete quadrilateral blow-up, nefness of -K follows from -K=H+(D0+D1+D2+D3)/2. Adjunction, Cauchy--Schwarz and Bezout force exactly six exceptional (-1), three diagonal (-1) and four side (-2) curves. Distinct diagonal curves meet once; Schur complement of the selected -1 block reduces negativity of selected side curves to a graph condition on K4. Summing the 64 labeled graphs yields 1+13t+69t^2+186t^3+260t^4+168t^5+29t^6; exact separate subset and graph programs return 726 with identical vectors. Classification is a proof, not finite extrapolation. Boundaries: complex field and smooth resolution only.

value.rationale: The uniquely maximally nodal cubic surface (4A1) is a canonical degeneration of the 27-line smooth cubic. The complete Zariski-chamber histogram of its smooth resolution is a natural, geometrically motivated divisor-theoretic invariant. The eleven-class graph formula explains precisely how four (-2) curves, six exceptional curves, and three diagonal (-1) curves constrain supports and isolates a substantive boundary from the smooth 2764 count. The claim is an exact natural classification, not an arbitrary slice or routine renaming; chamber volumes and adjacency remain unproved.
